statement: This sketch creates a hypnotic, three-dimensional geometric lattice composed of glowing planes, connecting lines, and floating nodes. The visualization operates entirely autonomously, with no user input required, presenting an ever-shifting abstract structure that feels both structured and organic. Individual planes orbit slowly around a central path while maintaining synchronized rotation, creating a unified motion that gives the entire system a sense of coherent movement and rhythm. The glowing elements emphasize intersections and connections between geometric forms, producing a mesmerizing visual effect where the boundaries between separate components dissolve into a continuous, flowing pattern. The color palette shifts subtly over time, enhancing the organic quality of the motion while maintaining strong visual contrast through the luminous effects.
